references.text: The description of the holy incense to be used in the tabernacle, which the golden bowl in Numbers 7:38 was filled with.
The golden bowls (kappot) made for the tabernacle, the same type of vessel mentioned here, filled with incense.
The making of the golden vessels for the tabernacle, including the bowls used for incense.
The first time a golden bowl filled with incense is mentioned in the consecration offering, as a pattern repeated for each tribal leader.
The summary of all twelve golden bowls filled with incense, totaling 120 shekels of gold.
The golden bowls full of incense in heaven represent the prayers of the saints, a spiritual fulfillment of the tabernacle picture.
The incense rising before God together with the prayers of the saints, linked to the incense offerings in the tabernacle.
